build_mmdet_package: build the mmdet detection toolbox package using python setup.py install with CUDA support
parse_requirements_file: parse a requirements.txt file and return a list of package dependencies with or without version specs
create_cuda_extension: create a CUDA or C++ extension module for PyTorch based on GPU availability
get_package_version: get the current package version string from the mmdet version.py file
review_setup_config: review the setup.py configuration for the mmdet OpenMMLab detection toolbox package
